title: “REAL STRENGTH” — Trusting God When It Still Hurts 🙏💔
paragraphs: “REAL STRENGTH” — Trusting God When It Still Hurts 🙏💔

Sometimes, faith doesn’t mean everything feels okay.
It means you still choose to trust — even when your heart is shattered.
Because true strength isn’t in how loud you shout your faith…
It’s in the quiet whisper that says,
“God, I still believe — even here, even now.” 🌅

💫 When it still hurts… trust Him anyway.
💫 When you don’t understand… praise Him still.
💫 When you feel weak… remember, His power is made perfect in weakness.

🎬 A cinematic moment of faith, hope, and surrender.
#RealStrength ✝️

“The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.”
— Psalm 34:18 (NIV)
